metadata.description: Turn your app/UI into a ~50s feature film — capture your real running app (or a mockup, a terminal, or a Remotion scene), narrated with Edge TTS (free by default; optional paid ElevenLabs), synced karaoke captions, music bed (free by default; optional paid ElevenLabs Music), brand framing. One brand.yaml.

plugins.name: demo-video
plugins.description: Produce a ~50s feature film of your app/UI. `/demo-video init` scaffolds into your project; edit brand.yaml (scenes + voiceover); `/demo-video build` produces final-framed.mp4. Capture your REAL running app (Playwright: click/type/scroll), HTML mockups for unbuilt features, screen recordings, terminal scenes (VHS), or Remotion scenes — composed with Edge TTS voiceover (optional paid ElevenLabs), karaoke captions, ducked music (optional paid ElevenLabs Music), and brand framing. A mandatory cost-gate protocol shows and requires explicit approval before any paid call. Output 1920×1080 H.264.
